comments.author: henrikdahlberg
comments.body: Question on the rollout design: if two replicas evaluate this flag mid-rollout, both execute the migration side effect and payouts get processed twice. Do we need a distributed lock before this merges, or is single-instance guaranteed somehow? I think this needs a concrete answer (and probably the lock) before merge.

comments.author: fennisworth
comments.body: Good question — anyone from the payouts side able to confirm single-instance?
